tests.name: rvalue_vector_string_moves
tests.intent: Verify that converting an rvalue vector of strings to JSON moves the string elements, leaving them empty in the source.

tests.name: lvalue_vector_string_copies
tests.intent: Verify that converting an lvalue vector of strings to JSON copies the elements, leaving the source intact.

tests.name: const_rvalue_vector_string_copies
tests.intent: Verify that converting a const rvalue vector of strings copies the elements and does not mutate the source.

tests.name: rvalue_map_string_string_moves
tests.intent: Verify that converting an rvalue map to JSON moves its values while keeping keys copied.

tests.name: rvalue_list_moves
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue std::list elements are moved when converted to a JSON array.

tests.name: rvalue_deque_moves
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue std::deque elements are moved when converted to a JSON array.

tests.name: rvalue_forward_list_moves
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue std::forward_list elements are moved when converted to a JSON array.

tests.name: rvalue_vector_bool_excluded
tests.intent: Verify that std::vector<bool> rvalue conversion uses its dedicated overload correctly.

tests.name: rvalue_valarray_excluded
tests.intent: Verify that std::valarray rvalue conversion still copies and is untouched by the new rvalue overloads.

tests.name: rvalue_array_type_excluded
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::array_t rvalues use their own existing overloads instead of the generic container one.

tests.name: rvalue_object_type_excluded
tests.intent: Verify that basic_json::object_t rvalues use their own existing overloads instead of the generic container one.

tests.name: nested_rvalue_containers
tests.intent: Verify that nested rvalue containers correctly move elements recursively into a JSON structure.

tests.name: rvalue_set_moves
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue std::set elements are successfully moved during conversion to a JSON array.

tests.name: rvalue_unordered_set_moves
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue std::unordered_set can be converted via rvalue overloads.

tests.name: rvalue_multimap_object
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue multimap works with object-like rvalue conversion.

tests.name: std_array_rvalue_moves
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue std::array moves its elements when converted to JSON.

tests.name: vector_int_rvalue_unchanged
tests.intent: Verify that primitive-type rvalue vector conversion functions correctly and produces expected JSON.

tests.name: rvalue_unordered_map_moves
tests.intent: Verify that rvalue std::unordered_map converts to an object with moved values.

tests.name: rvalue_initializer_list_behavior
tests.intent: Verify behavior of rvalue initializer lists with container to_json overloads.

tests.name: vector_json_rvalue_moves
tests.intent: Verify that an rvalue vector of json objects moves elements properly during conversion.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Test rvalue conversion of std::filesystem::path (if available) or check has_dedicated_to_json behavior on dedicated types to ensure they bypass generic container moving.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Test rvalue conversion of std::u8string (if available) to exercise dedicated string traits and has_dedicated_to_json.

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Test range view conversion traits by checking if range views (like std::views::all or similar if supported, or via is_range_view_type trait integration) are properly handled or excluded from generic movable container rvalues.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Test enum-keyed map type trait handling by converting an rvalue map with enum keys (if supported) or verifying object-like rvalue conversion constraints using is_rvalue_object_to_json.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Directly instantiate and invoke external_constructor<value_t::array>::construct_moving and external_constructor<value_t::object>::construct_moving via rvalue container forwarding to ensure full coverage of construct_moving lines and begin/end ADL lookups.
